description: Implementation of SbCPUFeaturesGet() for different CPU architectures (ARM and x86/x86_64) on Linux, parsing /proc/cpuinfo, using getauxval(), and CPUID instruction to detect CPU features.

classes.name: ProcCpuInfo
classes.description: Class that reads and parses /proc/cpuinfo to extract CPU feature strings and integers.

methods.name: SbCPUFeaturesGet
methods.description: Main function that detects CPU features based on architecture, calling architecture-specific functions.

methods.name: SbCPUFeaturesGet_ARM
methods.description: Detects ARM CPU features by reading /proc/cpuinfo, getauxval(), and hwcap flags.

methods.name: SbCPUFeaturesGet_X86
methods.description: Detects x86/x86_64 CPU features using CPUID instruction and /proc/cpuinfo.
